📦 Supply

How to receive goods in ANDERLECHT?

This process is to make sure all goods are received and registered and to make sure everybody understands its own responsability in the process.

The first thing to make sure is that for everybody is clear the full INBOUND Supply process:

Let’s breakdown now each of those steps and clarify what needs to be done:

After a purchase order is done (how to make a purchase order can be consulted at this link : ) the goods are prepared and then shipped.

When the suppliers send the notification that the goods have left the supplier warehouse and are in transit to Ahooga, the Purchasing department needs to validate the first Receipt transfer to validate the transfer of goods from the supplier warehouse to the “In Transit” location.

To do that follow the steps below (image below for reference):

1
Go to the purchase App >
2
Click on the PO order number you had notification of happened shipment from the supplier >
3
Click on the icon of the track with “receipt” message
4
if you want to be sure that you are validating the correct thing you should have in “receive from” the name of the supplier and in Destination location “AND/In Transit.
5
Validate the transfer to AND/In Transit
6
Transfer will now be moved to “Done” status , and Qty amount of that part will be in stock location “AND / In Transit “
7
Click now on “Next Transfer”
8
Now you will be in the next transfer of the goods – meaning the transfer from the “In/Transit” location to AND/Warehouse. You can verify it by checking the Source location in the transfer (AND/ In Transit) and destination location (AND/warehouse)
9
Add the Scheduled date date is expected the delivery to arrive in Anderlecht.
10
Click on the little wheel on top left corner and then click “PRINT” and then “picking operation”
11
You will have a PDF downloaded. It should look like the image below:
12
Print the PDF in paper and store it in the INBOUND AREA at the entrance of Anderlecht.
🔄 Responsibility changes to: Warehouse Manager — from this point the warehouse manager takes over the receipt process.
13
When any goods arrive the Warehouse manager needs to identity which paper is the relevant Inbound Picking operation for the goods that are in the entrance area.

Note: no good can leave the Inbound area without before being matched with a paper.

14
After identifying the correct paper for the inbound operation go in Odoo on your phone (either in a browser or Odoo App).
15
Select Barcode application > Click on the barcode with the moving red line
16
Scan the barcode of the delivery operation on the paper in the inbound area (the barcode after AND/STOR/...) ... if your phone is not able to read the barcode you can also write “AND/STOR/...” in the bar where to apply the code number in your phone and click “APPLY”.
17
Select the product in the phone by clicking with your finger or alternatively scan the Product Barcode – you can find the product barcode:
18
in the inbound picking operation paper
19
In the barcode catalogue available in the inbound area
20
Count the parts of that specific product and write the quantity on your phone.

Note: in case of receiving a bike you need to scan the lot serial number instad of counting the amount of bikes.

21
Validate the operation

Now the goods are moved in AND/Warehouse stock location!!!

22
Now the goods needs to be moved in the correct warehouse location. The objective is that everyone needs to be able to find the parts in the warehouse.

Store the parts according to the MAP below.
